aim_summary.goal: Add a continuous flat-bottom support step around the frame, offset 2 cm from the inner wall, with 0.5 cm thickness and a 0.2 cm filleted upper transition while leaving bottom edges sharp.
preserve_targets: bottom surface of the frame and supporting structure
aim_summary.expected_outcome: The frame has a continuous enlarged flat support at its bottom, sharp bottom edges, and a smooth 0.2 cm upper transition, supporting load over a larger surface area.

operations_plan.summary: Create the continuous offset supporting step at the bottom of the frame.

steps.description: Derive the bottom inner-wall boundary, offset it outward by 2 cm, and extrude the resulting annular region as the support step.

boundary_wire.value: cq.Wire.assembleEdges([e for f in faces_by_ids(['FACE 8','FACE 9','FACE 10','FACE 11','FACE 33','FACE 45','FACE 46','FACE 47']) for e in f.Edges() if any(e.isSame(b) for b in next(pf for pf in faces_by_ids(['FACE 12','FACE 34']) if not any(pe.isSame(fe) for pe in pf.Edges() for ff in faces_by_ids(['FACE 35','FACE 36','FACE 37','FACE 38','FACE 39','FACE 40','FACE 41','FACE 42']) for fe in ff.Edges())).Edges())])

expected_result.geometry: A continuous annular support step surrounds the frame bottom, its outer boundary is offset 2 cm from the inner-wall boundary, its requested thickness is 0.5 cm, and its bottom and bottom-edge boundaries remain flat and unfilleted.
expected_result.function: Enlarge the frame bottom surface and provide continuous support around the perimeter.
expected_result.behavior: Distribute bottom support over a larger flat area.

validation_criteria.description: The support step is continuous all around the frame and its boundary is offset 2 cm outward from the inner wall.
The supporting structure has a thickness of 0.5 cm in the clarified thickness direction.
No fillets are present on the final bottom-edge boundary of the support.
The support step enlarges the bottom surface area relative to the original frame.
The continuous enlarged bottom provides support around the complete frame perimeter.
The final bottom surface remains planar and all non-targeted frame geometry remains unchanged.

operations_plan.summary: Fillet the upper transition between the supporting step and the frame with a 0.2 cm radius.

steps.description: Apply the requested radius only to the all-around top-side transition edges of the new support step.

expected_result.geometry: The applicable upper perimeter edges where the support step transitions into the frame have continuous 0.2 cm fillets, while the bottom edges remain sharp and the bottom remains flat.
expected_result.function: Provide a smooth transition from the frame above into the support step.
expected_result.behavior: Avoid an abrupt upper transition without reducing the flat bottom support area.

validation_criteria.description: All applicable top-side transition edges between the support and frame have a 0.2 cm radius.
No 0.2 cm fillet or other radius is applied to the bottom-edge boundary.
The upper transition from the frame into the supporting step is smooth and continuous.
The flat bottom, F005 large outer edge fillet, and all other non-targeted frame geometry remain unchanged.
